# About X

> X's official company information hub covering brand guidelines, mission, values, and platform priorities across multiple languages.

About X serves as the central resource for understanding X's corporate identity, brand standards, and core values. The site provides localized content in multiple languages to reach global audiences and offers comprehensive branding resources for developers and partners.

## Key Topics

- X Platform
- Brand Guidelines
- Logo Assets
- Trademark Usage
- Company Mission
- Public Conversation
- Healthy Conversations
- Civic Integrity
- Security & Privacy
- Company Values
- Brand Toolkit
- Embed Tools
- Developer Resources
- Terms of Service

## Brand Resources & Toolkit

- [Brand Toolkit](https://about.x.com/en/who-we-are/brand-toolkit.html): X brand toolkit with logo, guidelines, and embed tools for developers

## Company Overview

- [About X (English)](https://about.x.com/en): English language company overview and mission for X platform
- [Acerca de X (Spanish)](https://about.x.com/es): Spanish language company overview and mission for X platform
- [À propos de X (French)](https://about.x.com/fr): French language company overview highlighting X values and safety
- [Sobre o X (Portuguese)](https://about.x.com/pt): Portuguese language company overview and X platform priorities
- [X Hakkında (Turkish)](https://about.x.com/tr): Turkish language company overview and X platform values
